nodes.label: Typography (Barlow, Barlow Semi Condensed)
nodes.rationale: Condensed signage type fits price boards and big totals; monospace headings read as a developer tool.

nodes.label: Folder Structure (thin controllers, services own transactions)
nodes.norm_label: folder structure (thin controllers, services own transactions)

nodes.label: Bar-top-at-night Visual Direction (dark only)
nodes.rationale: Smoked oak surfaces, foam text, single lager amber accent; numbers set large like a bar price board.

nodes.label: Flat Tonal Depth (no shadows, no blur)
nodes.norm_label: flat tonal depth (no shadows, no blur)
nodes.rationale: Blur costs tablet frame rate and lowers contrast in dim light; shadows vanish on dark backgrounds.

nodes.label: Changes from UI UX Pro Max Generator Draft
nodes.norm_label: changes from ui ux pro max generator draft
nodes.rationale: Replaced generic slate/green, glassmorphism, Fira fonts, hover lifts and light-mode modal specs with warm, flat, touch-first choices.

nodes.label: Status Colors with Text Labels
nodes.rationale: Status never shown by color alone; tints or 4px left rule, never large fills. Green kept free for available/paid.

nodes.label: Alpine.js + fetch to /api/v1 for POS
nodes.rationale: No server round trip per tap and POS exercises the same API as the mobile app; Livewire rejected as laggy on bar Wi-Fi, vanilla JS too much DOM code.

nodes.label: Alpine.js Integration (Alpine.start once)
nodes.rationale: Approved by the owner on 2026-11-18 (ARCHITECTURE.md 3.17).

nodes.label: /up Health Smoke Test
nodes.rationale: Pins the route so removing health: '/up' breaks the suite.

nodes.label: Stack: Laravel 13, PostgreSQL 18, Blade, Tailwind 4 (Vite), Alpine.js
nodes.norm_label: stack: laravel 13, postgresql 18, blade, tailwind 4 (vite), alpine.js

nodes.label: Local Setup on Windows (PowerShell)
nodes.rationale: PHP 8.4 must precede XAMPP PHP 8.2 on PATH; terminals opened before the change keep the old PATH.

nodes.label: Scaffold Skeleton in Temp Folder and Move Into Repo
nodes.norm_label: scaffold skeleton in temp folder and move into repo
nodes.rationale: Existing docs/, CLAUDE.md, .claude/ and graphify-out/ survive.

nodes.label: Concurrency and Lock Order
nodes.rationale: Lock order session then inventory items sorted by id prevents deadlocks; reference numbers from row ids avoid counter tables.

nodes.label: Recipe Components (case-to-bottle, bottle-to-shot)
nodes.rationale: One recipe table covers bottles, buckets, shots and cocktails, so no separate conversion and bundle features. Base unit plus inventory_units factors.

nodes.label: Stock Deduction on Send Round
nodes.rationale: Drinks leave the shelf when ordered; deduct at send in one transaction. Voids ask return-to-stock; never block on negative stock (owner decision).

nodes.label: Moving Weighted Average Cost (WAC)
nodes.rationale: Chosen over FIFO (cost layers, much more code) and standard cost (drifts). Cost snapshot taken at send under lock.

nodes.label: UI Component Kit (x-ui.* anonymous Blade components)
nodes.norm_label: ui component kit (x-ui.* anonymous blade components)

nodes.label: Tailwind 4 @theme Design Tokens (dark high-contrast)
nodes.rationale: Dark high-contrast palette for a dim bar; Tailwind 4 has no JS config so tokens live in app.css.

nodes.label: Code Structure (Services, Form Requests, Policies, Blade components, API Resources)
nodes.norm_label: code structure (services, form requests, policies, blade components, api resources)

nodes.label: Last Active Owner and Self-Deactivation Protection
nodes.norm_label: last active owner and self-deactivation protection

nodes.label: Native dialog Modals
nodes.rationale: Focus trap, Esc and inert background without an Alpine plugin.

nodes.label: ActivityLog Eloquent Append-Only Guard
nodes.rationale: updating/deleting throw LogicException before any SQL; second layer above the DB trigger.

nodes.label: ActivityLogger Injectable Service
nodes.rationale: Kept injectable instead of static: services already inject it and tests can swap it.

nodes.label: HasAuditedSoftDeletes Trait
nodes.rationale: Records who archived via activity log (<model>.archived/restored) instead of a deleted_by column: one source of truth for who.

nodes.label: Minimal activity_logs Table and ActivityLogger (Step 4)
nodes.rationale: Built in the auth step because the audit rule applies to login and account changes.

nodes.label: Audit Trail Rule (ActivityLogger::log, <module>.<verb>)
nodes.rationale: Log only changed fields in the same DB transaction; never log passwords, PINs or tokens.

nodes.label: HasAuditedSoftDeletes Soft-Delete Convention
nodes.rationale: Query-builder delete()/forceDelete() skip model events, so only model delete()/restore() inside the service transaction are allowed; forceDelete() throws.

nodes.label: No Hard Deletes Rule
nodes.rationale: Financial, inventory, payroll and audit records use soft deletes, voids, reversals or archival; corrections are new records.

nodes.label: Removed Breeze Features (registration, reset, verification, account delete)
nodes.norm_label: removed breeze features (registration, reset, verification, account delete)
nodes.rationale: No mail configured and no hard deletes; change-my-password kept.

nodes.label: Money and Stock Feature Test Rule
nodes.norm_label: money and stock feature test rule

nodes.label: Payment Rule (Paid only when payments cover total, lockForUpdate)
nodes.norm_label: payment rule (paid only when payments cover total, lockforupdate)

nodes.label: Tests on PostgreSQL, Not SQLite
nodes.rationale: Later steps rely on PostgreSQL row locking and decimal behavior that SQLite does not reproduce.

nodes.label: OwnerSeeder from OWNER_* env
nodes.rationale: No hardcoded password; seeding fails if OWNER_PASSWORD is empty and never resets an existing password.

nodes.label: Seeded Roles (Owner, Cashier, Supervisor, Bartender, Staff, Inventory Manager)
nodes.norm_label: seeded roles (owner, cashier, supervisor, bartender, staff, inventory manager)

nodes.label: App\Support\Navigation (permission and Route::has filtered)
nodes.rationale: Modules appear in nav automatically when their routes exist.

nodes.label: No Fake Dashboard Numbers and Seeder Rules
nodes.norm_label: no fake dashboard numbers and seeder rules

nodes.label: Route Guard Test (every authenticated route has can: middleware)
nodes.norm_label: route guard test (every authenticated route has can: middleware)
nodes.rationale: Later modules cannot ship unguarded.

nodes.label: Cashier Shifts and Expected Drawer Cash
nodes.norm_label: cashier shifts and expected drawer cash

nodes.label: Revenue, Purchases, COGS, OpEx and Payroll Separation
nodes.norm_label: revenue, purchases, cogs, opex and payroll separation
nodes.rationale: Each figure has one source table; no Product purchases or Salaries expense categories; cash drawer movements never in P&L; purchases become COGS only when sold.

nodes.label: Business Date Cutoff (06:00)
nodes.rationale: business_date stored at write time via BusinessDate::for so later cutoff changes never move past records between days.

nodes.label: Money Precision: totals 12,2 and unit costs 14,6
nodes.norm_label: money precision: totals 12,2 and unit costs 14,6
nodes.rationale: Per-ml costs cannot be stored at 2 decimals without error on every shot; bcmath with round half-up to 2 decimals for amounts.

nodes.label: Schedules Overlap Exclusion Constraint
nodes.rationale: gist exclusion on tstzrange rejects overlapping shifts at the DB, including shifts across midnight.

nodes.label: ActivityLogger Service
nodes.rationale: Called inside the same transaction as the change; custom table instead of spatie/laravel-activitylog (not pre-approved, little benefit).

nodes.label: Append-only PostgreSQL Trigger
nodes.rationale: History cannot be edited or deleted, even by a bug. Applies to activity_logs, inventory_movements, payments, refunds, order_item_voids, price_histories, cash_movements.

nodes.label: Derived Table Status and Session Lifecycle
nodes.norm_label: derived table status and session lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Two stored statuses that must agree will eventually disagree; Occupied/Awaiting Payment derive from the open session. One open primary session per table enforced by partial unique index.

nodes.label: Tab Actions: Move, Merge, Split (child sessions)
nodes.norm_label: tab actions: move, merge, split (child sessions)
nodes.rationale: Split bills as child sessions so payments, receipts and totals need no special cases; rejected payment allocation to order items. Allowed only before any payment.

nodes.label: Versioned REST API under /api/v1
nodes.rationale: Designed so a future mobile app can use the same backend.

nodes.label: activity_logs user_id/action Filter Indexes
nodes.rationale: The log grows with every business action, so filters need indexes.

nodes.label: ActivityLog filter Scope (user, action, Manila date range)
nodes.norm_label: activitylog filter scope (user, action, manila date range)

nodes.label: Username Login (lowercase unique, email optional)
nodes.rationale: Bar staff may have no email.
